content: The cost of QD-OLED gaming monitors is going down, even as many other PC components are still soaring above their normal prices. If your budget is locked at $300, Samsung’s 27-inch 1440p model costs exactly that much thanks to a recent $50 discount at Amazon. Finding a good QD-OLED monitor under $500 these days is pretty easy, but under $300 is pretty rare. Its G50SF debuted at $499.99, but has spent the past six months bouncing back and forth between $350 and $450. [Product: Samsung 27-inch G50SF QD-OLED | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FNQDNGXY/?tag=theverge02-20] Despite being cheaper than Alienware’s awesome $350 AW2726DM and some competitors, the Samsung G50SF doesn’t make a ton of compromises. It has a thin design, variable refresh rate support, and the same fast .03-millisecond response time we expect from these panels. It has a DisplayPort port plus HDMI 2.0 and a headphone jack (most competing monitors have two HDMI ports). Unless you’re keen on getting a monitor that has a 240Hz or faster refresh rate, you may not mind that this one tops out at 180Hz (via DisplayPort), or 144Hz via HDMI. Some other Verge-approved deals * Maybe you knew that Best Buy’s in-house Insignia brand has its own AirTag-like Bluetooth trackers, maybe you didn’t. I recently found out, and they’re surprisingly affordable; You can get a four-pack of its Apple Find My-compatible trackers for $19.99 ($10 off). It’s a nice price if you just want some low-cost trackers with lanyard hooks to attach to luggage before a trip. The tracker’s coin battery can be replaced, and its 65-decibel alarm can help you find lost items nearby. Insignia advertises up to a 164-foot Bluetooth range outdoors (or 65 feet indoors), but connecting them with Find My will let you track them from greater distances. * Sony is hosting a summer sale on physical PlayStation 5 games, and it includes fairly new and notable releases like Saros ($49.99, $20 off), Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 ($29.99, $40 off), and Death Stranding 2: On The Beach ($39.88, $30 off), plus several other great games worth considering. The sale is happening at Amazon, Best Buy, and GameStop. These are some of the biggest discounts we’ve seen on physical titles, and digital versions on the PlayStation Store are matching these prices. * Those who work all day at a computer might be familiar with having sore wrists, particularly from using a mouse. A vertical mouse might help, and you can get one of the better wireless models out there — Logitech’s MX Vertical — for $46.80 at Woot with the code LOGITECH22 used at checkout (usually $77 elsewhere). The mouse recharges via USB-C and can last for months with a single charge, according to my colleague Victoria Song, who loves hers. It can connect to devices with its included 2.4GHz receiver, or Bluetooth.

chineseContent: 尽管许多其他 PC 组件的价格仍然高于正常价格，但 QD-OLED 游戏显示器的成本正在下降。如果您的预算锁定在 300 美元，三星 27 英寸 1440p 型号的价格正是这个价格，这要归功于亚马逊最近的 50 美元折扣。如今，找到一款价格低于 500 美元的优质 QD-OLED 显示器非常容易，但低于 300 美元的则相当罕见。它的 G50SF 首发价格为 499.99 美元，但过去六个月一直在 350 美元到 450 美元之间波动。 【产品：三星27英寸G50SF QD-OLED | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FNQDNGXY/?tag=theverge02-20] 尽管比 Alienware 350 美元的 AW2726DM 和一些竞争对手便宜，但三星 G50SF 并没有做出太多妥协。它具有薄型设计、可变刷新率支持以及与我们期望的这些面板相同的 0.03 毫秒快速响应时间。它有一个 DisplayPort 端口加上 HDMI 2.0 和一个耳机插孔（大多数竞争显示器都有两个 HDMI 端口）。除非您热衷于购买具有 240Hz 或更快刷新率的显示器，否则您可能不介意这款显示器的最高刷新率为 180Hz（通过 DisplayPort）或通过 HDMI 达到 144Hz。其他一些 Verge 批准的交易 * 也许您知道百思买的内部 Insignia 品牌有自己的类似 AirTag 的蓝牙跟踪器，也许您不知道。我最近发现，它们的价格出奇地便宜；您可以花 19.99 美元（优惠 10 美元）购买四件装的 Apple Find My 兼容追踪器。如果您只是想要一些带有挂绳钩的低成本追踪器，以便在旅行前将其挂在行李上，那么这个价格很不错。该追踪器的纽扣电池可以更换，其 65 分贝警报可以帮助您找到附近丢失的物品。 Insignia 宣称户外蓝牙范围可达 164 英尺（或室内 65 英尺），但通过“查找我的”连接它们可以让您从更远的距离跟踪它们。 * 索尼
